source.title: Information Bulletin - Joint Entrance Examination (Main) - 2027
source.pages: printed pp.15-20 (§2.1 mode, §2.3 scheme, §2.4 Paper 2B pattern and marking, §2.5 duration), pp.56-61 (Appendix III)

additional_sources.title: Public Notice: Inviting Online Application Form for Joint Entrance Examination (Main) - 2027 (Session 1)

duration_rules.compensatory_rule: Not less than 20 minutes per hour for candidates eligible for a scribe (Note 2.5).

shift_timings.note: Public notice p.2 lists Paper 2B in the first shift.

scoring.merit: Raw scores in Mathematics, Aptitude Test, Planning Based Test and total are converted to NTA scores; merit merges NTA scores of all shifts of both sessions (§2.4 Paper 2B item 4).
tie_break_order: NTA score in Planning Based Questions
Lower ratio of attempted incorrect to correct answers in all subjects
Lower ratio of attempted incorrect to correct answers in Mathematics (Part I)
Lower ratio of attempted incorrect to correct answers in Aptitude Test (Part II)
Lower ratio of attempted incorrect to correct answers in Planning Based Questions (Part III)

instructions.en: Paper 2B has 100 questions for 400 marks in 180 minutes, all on the computer: Mathematics (20 MCQs in Section A and 5 numerical-value questions in Section B, 100 marks), Aptitude Test (50 MCQs, 200 marks) and Planning-Based Questions (25 MCQs, 100 marks). Each question carries +4 for a correct answer and -1 for an incorrect answer; unanswered questions get 0.
instructions.hi: पेपर 2B में 180 मिनट में 400 अंकों के 100 प्रश्न हैं, सभी कंप्यूटर पर: गणित (खंड A में 20 बहुविकल्पीय प्रश्न और खंड B में 5 संख्यात्मक मान वाले प्रश्न, 100 अंक), अभिक्षमता परीक्षा (50 बहुविकल्पीय प्रश्न, 200 अंक) और नियोजन-आधारित प्रश्न (25 बहुविकल्पीय प्रश्न, 100 अंक)। प्रत्येक प्रश्न में सही उत्तर पर +4 और गलत उत्तर पर -1 अंक हैं; बिना उत्तर वाले प्रश्नों पर 0 अंक।

instructions_basis: Summary in our own words of bulletin §2.4 (Paper 2B); not the official screen text.
notes: Smriti has no subject IDs for the Aptitude Test or Planning parts, so 'subject' is null for those sections.
The bulletin's Paper 2B marking table names 'MCQs' generally; it is applied to Mathematics Section A, Aptitude and Planning alike (§2.4 Paper 2B item 2).
